HEADER: Init +0; Senses Dragon senses, tremorsense 120 ft.; Perception +15
DEFENSE: DR 5/magic; Immune Earth, Paralysis, Sleep; Resist Lightning 50%
OFFENSE: Melee Bite +20 (2d6+13), 2 Claws +20 (1d8+9), Gore +20 (1d8+13), Tail Slap +15 (1d8+13)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite & gore)
Special Attacks Breath Weapon (80-ft. line, 6d10 earth damage, Reflex DC 22 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Earthquake, Eerie Howl, Sandstorm, Slow Breath (40-ft. cone, DC 21)
At will - detect magic, ignite, mending, message, read magic
2nd (DC 17) - binding earth, elemental resistance, groundswell, soften earth and stone, stone call, wall climb
3rd (DC 18) - dispel, meld into stone, shifting sand, stone shape
STATISTICS: Str 28, Dex 10, Con 22, Int 10, Wis 20, Cha 14
Base Atk +12; CMB +22; CMD 32 (36 vs. trip)
Feats Cleave, Improved Bull Rush, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Toughness
Skills Bluff +16, Climb +27, Intimidate +16, Knowledge (dungeoneering, local) +14, Perception +19, Stealth +14; Racial Modifiers +4 Climb, +4 Stealth
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Earthquake (su) Once every 1d3 rounds as a standard action, a brown dragon can cause the ground to erupt around it within a 30-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect take 8d6 points of earth damage and are inflicted with the Weighted status effect for 1d6 rounds (Reflex save DC 21 for half damage and negates the status effect). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

Eerie Howl (su) Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, a brown dragon can emit a loud, piercing howl within a 10-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect are inflicted with Disable status (Fortitude save DC 21 to negate) for 1d4 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 25).
Slow Breath (su) Instead of a line of jagged rocks, a brown dragon can breathe a cone of slowing gas. Those in the cone must make a Fortitude save or be slowed (as per the spell slow) for 1d6 rounds.

Triumphant Roar (su) As a standard action, the brown dragon releases a raging fierce roar, boosting their personal attack power. This adds a +6 morale bonus to all attack rolls for eleven rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

curation.summary: Juvenile Brown Dragon is packaged as an FFD20 NPC actor with 39 generated item(s) across 8 populated mechanics categories.
rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
